selected_by: latest archived year with 10 or more flight-speed tracked individuals
previous_2014_result: unavailable, no 2014 GPS in archived source; do not alter
native_filter: source outliers excluded, speed 5 to 55 m/s, earliest GPS fix per bird per UTC five-minute bin before altitude
training: At least 10 same-bird other-day and 10 other-bird other-date events in same cell
evaluation: At least 50 scored fixes per day on 2 days per bird, and at least 10 birds for main endpoint
claim_boundary: Failure of same-cell repeat is a migration/central-place difference in observation support, not lack of ecological individuality.
next: Run this gate before writing or opening any 2013 altitude outcome.
